protocol.decisionCadence: every completed M15 candle, 06:00-15:45 UTC, next-open entry
protocol.heads: pairwise DIRECTION head + POSITIVE_R QUALITY head; WAIT when quality<threshold or direction confidence<min
protocol.newsFeatures: polarity-adjusted signed post-release surprise toward EUR/USD (decayed), minutes since/to next release, post-news flag, magnitude; surprise only from releases before entry
protocol.execution: historical bid/ask, 0.1 pip entry+exit slippage, same-candle ambiguity charged to stop, 180-min max hold, +-60min high-impact news blackout, max 3/day, one open position

split.walkForward: expanding past-only, retrain every 2 months, min 6m train, frozen config

selection.objective: validation only: >=30 trades and PF>1, then maximize robust expectancy; never selected on test; no win-rate target
